sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN Rx buffer and FIFO element
sections.text_helper: Section 71.4.19 "FDCAN Rx buffer and FIFO element" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3671.
sections.section_content:
Up to 64 Rx buffers and two Rx FIFOs can be configured in the message RAM. Each Rx
FIFO section can be configured to store up to 64 received messages. The structure of a
Rx buffer / FIFO element is shown in Table708, the description is provided in Table709.
[Table 708. Rx buffer and FIFO element]
The element size can be configured for storage of CAN FD messages with up to 64 bytes
data field via register FDCAN_RXESC.
[Table 709. Rx buffer and FIFO element description]
